post.summary: Ask a question about your files.
post.description:
The answer streams as `text/event-stream`: one `sources` event (the
numbered passages the answer may cite, see `ChatSources`), `delta` events
with pieces of text (`ChatDelta`), then `done` (`ChatDone`: the stored
message id, status, final text, citations and token usage) or `error`
(`ChatError`). Answers cite sources as `[n]`.

When the best passage is too weak, the answer is "I couldn't find this in
your files." without asking the model (`status: refused`); with no model
configured, the passages are returned with `status: no_llm`. Closing the
connection stops generation. Limited per user (`AKASHA_CHAT_RATE_PER_MINUTE`).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only files carrying this tag (their own or a suggested one).

post.description:
The body is streamed to storage, never held in memory. The type is detected from
the bytes and must be on the allow-list; it must also agree with the filename's
extension. Re-uploading bytes you already have returns the existing file with
`200` instead of `201`. New files start as `pending` with an extraction job queued.

get.summary: One of your files, with the state of its extraction job.

delete.summary: Delete a file. Its contents are removed once no other file uses them.

patch.summary: Rename, pin/unpin or retag a file (or drop model-suggested tags).

get.summary: Download a file's contents (always as an attachment, never rendered inline).

200.description: The file's bytes, with its detected `Content-Type`

post.summary:
Ask the language model again for the file's summary and suggested tags
(e.g. after a failure or a model change). Your own tags are never changed.
The result shows up on the file once the background job ran. Needs a
configured language model; limited per user.

409.description: The file is not ready yet

get.summary: The text extracted from one of your files, a window at a time.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: First character to return (0-based, in Unicode characters). Default 0.

404.description: No such file, or not extracted yet

post.summary: Extract a file again (e.g. after a failure). Puts it back to `pending`.

get.summary: Files similar to one of yours, by embedding (mean of the file's chunk vectors).

A preview of an image file, at most 256 px on its longer side (JPEG, or PNG
for images with transparency).
get.description:
Generated in the background after upload: `404` until it exists, and always
`404` for files that have no preview (PDFs, text, media, images too large or
damaged to decode; clients show a type icon instead). Send the `ETag` back in
`If-None-Match` to get `304 Not Modified`.

delete.summary: Permanently delete the account and everything it owns.

post.summary: Change password. Signs out every other session.

get.summary: Search your files; results are grouped by file with their best passages.
get.description:
When semantic search is unavailable (model not installed or still loading),
the search runs as keyword search and the response says so (`degraded`,
`warnings`) instead of failing.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
What to look for, 1-500 characters. Web-search syntax: `"exact phrase"`,
`or`, and `-word` to exclude.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Uploaded on or after: a date (`2026-01-31`, UTC) or an RFC 3339 timestamp.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Uploaded on or before this date (inclusive), or before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags; files must carry all of them.

parameters.name: file_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated file ids (up to 100) to search within.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page (default 1). Only the first 200 results can be paged through.

parameters.name: rerank
parameters.description: Reorder the top results with the cross-encoder, if one is configured (default true).

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up. Never touches dependencies.
Readiness: the process can serve traffic (database reachable).

ids.description: Up to 100 file ids. Ids that are unknown (or not yours) are ignored.

ChatDelta.description: `event: delta`: the next piece of the answer text.

citations.description:
The sources the answer cites, in order of first citation (for `no_llm`:
every source).

content.description:
The final answer text. Use it instead of the concatenated deltas: a
refusal replaces partial output.

model.description: `provider/model` that wrote the answer; `null` when none did.

ChatError.description: `event: error`: the answer failed. Partial output is stored with status `error`.

message_id.description: The stored (partial) answer, if it could be saved.

ChatSources.description: `event: sources`: the passages the answer may cite (empty when refused).

search_query.description:
The query that was searched (the question, or a standalone rewrite of a
follow-up).

ChunkHit.description: A chunk-level result: the chunk, its full text and its file.

ChunkMatch.description: A matching chunk, located for citation.

char_start.description: `[char_start, char_end)` of the chunk in the file's extracted text (characters).

page.description: 1-based PDF page; `null` for formats without pages.

Citation.description:
A numbered passage from the user's files: shown to the model as `[n]`, and
stored with an answer that cites it.

char_start.description: `[char_start, char_end)` of the passage in the file's extracted text (characters).

page.description: 1-based PDF page; `null` for formats without pages.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

title.description: Empty until the first question (or a rename) names it.
Optional; otherwise the first question becomes the title.

model.description: `provider/model` that wrote the summary and tags.

EnrichmentStatus.description: How the last enrichment (summary and suggested tags) went.

char_count.description: Length of the whole text in characters.

extractor.description:
`text`, `markdown`, `csv`, `json`, `pdf`, `ocr`, or `none` when nothing could be
extracted (e.g. audio and video, which are not transcribed yet).

next_offset.description: Pass as `offset` to read on; `null` at the end.

notes.description: Remarks such as "OCR is disabled" or "truncated".

offset.description: Character offset of `text` in the whole text.

page_count.description: Pages in the document; `null` for formats without pages.

text.description: The requested window of the text.

oneOf.description: Latest processing job (extraction or embedding), if one was ever queued.

FileDetail.description: One file plus the state of its latest processing job.

FileHit.description: A file-level result: the file and its best matching chunks.

match_count.description: Matching chunks of this file among the candidates.

matches.description: Up to three best chunks, best first.

FileInfo.description: The file a result belongs to.

auto_tags.description: Tags suggested by the language model.

summary.description: Model-written description of the file, when there is one.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

auto_tags.description:
Tags suggested by the language model, minus any already in `tags`.
Filtering and searching by tag match both lists.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the contents, lowercase hex.

oneOf.description: State of the model-written summary and tags; `null`: not enriched (yet).

mime_type.description: Detected from the contents, not taken from the client.

summary.description: A short model-written description, once the file was enriched.

tags.description: The user's own tags (never changed by the model).

Highlight.description: A highlighted span of a snippet, `[start, end)` in Unicode characters.

items.description: Oldest first within the page; pages go back in time.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get older messages; `null` when there are none.

citations.description: Sources cited by an answer (empty for questions).

PageSource.description: Where a PDF page's text came from.

PageSpan.description: A PDF page's span in the full text (`char_start..char_end`, in characters).

file_ids.description: Only answer from these files (up to 100).

tags.description: Only answer from files carrying all of these tags.

oneOf.description: Only answer from files of this kind.

next_attempt_at.description: When it will next be tried (`queued` or `failed` only).

ProcessingStage.description: Which processing step a job performs.

Scores.description: Why a chunk ranked where it did.

fused.description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion score (sum of `1 / (60 + rank)` over the retrievers).

rerank.description: Cross-encoder score (model specific scale), when reranked.

degraded.description: `true` when the search ran in a weaker mode than requested.

mode.description: The mode that actually ran: `keyword` when semantic search was unavailable.

reranked.description: `true` when the top results were reordered by the reranker.

suggestion.description:
"Did you mean": the query with misspelt-looking words replaced by similar
words from your documents. Only when keyword search found few matches.

warnings.description: Why the search was degraded or not reranked, for display or debugging.

SimilarFile.description: A file similar to another one.

similarity.description: Cosine similarity of its closest chunk to the source file's mean embedding.

items.description: Most similar first. Empty while the file is not embedded yet.

Snippet.description: An excerpt of a chunk (plain text, never HTML) with the query terms marked.

text.description: Up to two fragments joined by " … "; the chunk's start when no term matched.

Timings.description: Milliseconds spent per stage (stages that did not run are 0).

keyword_ms.description: Keyword and file-name queries (and the spelling suggestion, when made).

TokenUsage.description: Token counts reported by the provider.

auto_tags.description:
Replaces the model-suggested tags (e.g. to drop a wrong one); same rules
as `tags`. Re-running enrichment replaces them again; to keep a
suggestion for good, add it to `tags`.

tags.description: Replaces all tags. Trimmed and lowercased; at most 32, each 1–50 characters.

display_name.description: New display name; `null` or blank clears it.

file.description: The file. Its type is detected from the bytes; the filename is sanitised.
